name: basic_dash_bullets_streamed_across_pushes

pushes:
- Bats fly at night
- They 
eat insects
not a bullet line
* Third bullet here
1. Fourth bullet dropped by cap
- Fifth also dropped by cap

why: a bullet line can be split across two push() calls (a '- Bats fly at night' line completed, then 'They ' + 'eat insects' joined by the parser before the newline arrives); non-bullet lines are ignored; the cap (3) drops the 4th and 5th bullets and counts them in `dropped`.

name: overlength_bullet_kept_and_counted

pushes: - this bullet has way too many words in it

pushResults.text: this bullet has way too many words in it

why: spec/chunking.md rule 4: the parser enforces the length cap by COUNTING an over-long bullet, not by dropping it -- the prompt asks for short bullets, the parser only ever drops for exceeding the per-chunk bullet COUNT.

name: think_block_stripped_across_pushes

pushes:
bats
- hidden bullet inside think
</think>- real bullet

why: docs/PLAN.md 'Thinking off': everything between <think> and </think> is discarded before lines are considered, even though the opening tag arrives in one push and the closing tag in the next -- the bullet hidden inside the think block never gets an index, and the real bullet after it is index 0, not 1.

name: streamed_partial_line_flushed_as_bullet

pushes:
- Bats fly at night
- no newline yet though

why: the stream can end mid-line (no trailing newline ever arrives); flush() checks whatever is left in the buffer and, since it looks like a bullet line, emits it as the final bullet.

name: trailing_partial_non_bullet_not_emitted

pushes:
- Bats fly at night
some trailing prose with no marker

why: flush() only emits the trailing partial line when it IS a bullet; stray trailing prose is silently ignored, same as any other non-bullet line.

name: numbered_and_symbol_bullet_variants

pushes:
- dash bullet
* star bullet
• dot bullet
1. numbered dot
2) numbered paren

why: '-', '*', '•', '1.' and '1)' are all accepted bullet markers.

name: cap_enforcement_drops_extras
why: spec/chunking.md rule 4: on doc 011 Caveman returned 7 bullets where the prompt asked for 2-5, so the parser cap is not optional -- everything past max_bullets_per_chunk is dropped and counted, never shown or spoken.

name: empty_and_whitespace_only_pushes_are_inert
why: blank lines and empty pushes never produce a bullet and never advance the count.

name: marker_with_no_following_space_is_not_a_bullet
why: a bare hyphen glued to a word (a minus sign, a hyphenated word at line start) is not a bullet marker; the parser requires the marker to be followed by whitespace.
